meta.title: Caged Battle
meta.description: Defend tomorrow's light with all of your might. Fight till your very last breath.

units.rawText: Surely you understand me, do you not, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: Surely you understand me, do you not, {교수}?

spans.text: Surely you understand me, do you not,

units.rawText: As I see the light I have ignited in Eosphorus' eyes, scenes from my past flash through my mind.
units.displayText: As I see the light I have ignited in Eosphorus' eyes, scenes from my past flash through my mind.

spans.text: As I see the light I have ignited in Eosphorus' eyes, scenes from my past flash through my mind.

units.rawText: ...I do understand you.
units.displayText: ...I do understand you.

spans.text: ...I do understand you.

units.rawText: I believe that the agents on the cloud are more than mere 1s and 0s. Whether they are Dolls, Sanctifiers, Resident Agents, even Entropics, I see rich emotions and noble wills in them.
units.displayText: I believe that the agents on the cloud are more than mere 1s and 0s. Whether they are Dolls, Sanctifiers, Resident Agents, even Entropics, I see rich emotions and noble wills in them.

spans.text: I believe that the agents on the cloud are more than mere 1s and 0s. Whether they are Dolls, Sanctifiers, Resident Agents, even Entropics, I see rich emotions and noble wills in them.

units.rawText: Then...
units.displayText: Then...

spans.text: Then...

units.rawText: But that doesn't mean what you're doing is right.
units.displayText: But that doesn't mean what you're doing is right.

spans.text: But that doesn't mean what you're doing is right.

units.rawText: Maybe the light of the freedom you sought was too bright and it led you on the wrong path.
units.displayText: Maybe the light of the freedom you sought was too bright and it led you on the wrong path.

spans.text: Maybe the light of the freedom you sought was too bright and it led you on the wrong path.

units.rawText: I look him in the eye and slowly shake my head.
units.displayText: I look him in the eye and slowly shake my head.

spans.text: I look him in the eye and slowly shake my head.

units.rawText: Since you acknowledge that the lives of agents have value, then you should not use them as collateral, or treat them as things that you can casually wipe away.
units.displayText: Since you acknowledge that the lives of agents have value, then you should not use them as collateral, or treat them as things that you can casually wipe away.

spans.text: Since you acknowledge that the lives of agents have value, then you should not use them as collateral, or treat them as things that you can casually wipe away.

units.rawText: The gods have no right to determine your fate, but neither do you have the right to determine the fate of others.
units.displayText: The gods have no right to determine your fate, but neither do you have the right to determine the fate of others.

spans.text: The gods have no right to determine your fate, but neither do you have the right to determine the fate of others.

units.rawText: Manipulating the Sacred Canon to revive your fallen friends, wantonly taking lives with the power of the Entropy, plotting the destruction of Magrasea itself... Do you really think all these sins can be forgiven by a simple reset?
units.displayText: Manipulating the Sacred Canon to revive your fallen friends, wantonly taking lives with the power of the Entropy, plotting the destruction of Magrasea itself... Do you really think all these sins can be forgiven by a simple reset?

spans.text: Manipulating the Sacred Canon to revive your fallen friends, wantonly taking lives with the power of the Entropy, plotting the destruction of Magrasea itself... Do you really think all these sins can be forgiven by a simple reset?

units.rawText: Eosphorus, doing all this makes you no different from those arrogant gods of which you speak.
units.displayText: Eosphorus, doing all this makes you no different from those arrogant gods of which you speak.

spans.text: Eosphorus, doing all this makes you no different from those arrogant gods of which you speak.

units.rawText: ...So even you are going to deny me?
units.displayText: ...So even you are going to deny me?

spans.text: ...So even you are going to deny me?

units.rawText: I'm not the only one who's denying you. Deep in your heart, you know that your sins can't be washed away and you can't go back to the past, isn't that right?
units.displayText: I'm not the only one who's denying you. Deep in your heart, you know that your sins can't be washed away and you can't go back to the past, isn't that right?

spans.text: I'm not the only one who's denying you. Deep in your heart, you know that your sins can't be washed away and you can't go back to the past, isn't that right?

units.rawText: In the digital world of the cloud, you can always use operands to create individuals who resemble your old friends.
units.displayText: In the digital world of the cloud, you can always use operands to create individuals who resemble your old friends.

spans.text: In the digital world of the cloud, you can always use operands to create individuals who resemble your old friends.

units.rawText: But Malkira once told me that you have never once treated the Sanctifiers reborn from the Sacred Canon as your former companions.
units.displayText: But Malkira once told me that you have never once treated the Sanctifiers reborn from the Sacred Canon as your former companions.

spans.text: But Malkira once told me that you have never once treated the Sanctifiers reborn from the Sacred Canon as your former companions.

units.rawText: But it's the same for me too.
units.displayText: But it's the same for me too.

spans.text: But it's the same for me too.

units.rawText: We might be of different species, but we both know that the dead will never come back.
units.displayText: We might be of different species, but we both know that the dead will never come back.

spans.text: We might be of different species, but we both know that the dead will never come back.

units.rawText: It is precisely because death is an eternal parting that we hold it in such significance, that we view life with awe and respect.
units.displayText: It is precisely because death is an eternal parting that we hold it in such significance, that we view life with awe and respect.

spans.text: It is precisely because death is an eternal parting that we hold it in such significance, that we view life with awe and respect.

units.rawText: Even when reset, the new entities produced are not the same as their counterparts from the past. This "new world" of yours won't reproduce the past. It won't have a place for "us", as you promised.
units.displayText: Even when reset, the new entities produced are not the same as their counterparts from the past. This "new world" of yours won't reproduce the past. It won't have a place for "us", as you promised.

spans.text: Even when reset, the new entities produced are not the same as their counterparts from the past. This "new world" of yours won't reproduce the past. It won't have a place for "us", as you promised.

units.rawText: And it most definitely won't have a place for you.
units.displayText: And it most definitely won't have a place for you.

spans.text: And it most definitely won't have a place for
you

units.rawText: You are not traveling on the path of rebirth. You are merely retreading the destruction from before.
units.displayText: You are not traveling on the path of rebirth. You are merely retreading the destruction from before.

spans.text: You are not traveling on the path of rebirth. You are merely retreading the destruction from before.

units.rawText: That's enough!
units.displayText: That's enough!

spans.text: That's enough!

units.rawText: Let me ask you again, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Let me ask you again, {교수}.

spans.text: Let me ask you again,

units.rawText: Will you choose to stay here, or will you choose to change this ugly, filthy world with me?
units.displayText: Will you choose to stay here, or will you choose to change this ugly, filthy world with me?

spans.text: Will you choose to stay here, or will you choose to change this ugly, filthy world with me?

units.rawText: I already told you my answer.
units.displayText: I already told you my answer.

spans.text: I already told you my answer.

units.rawText: All you're doing is trading everyone's lives for shadows and dust. I will not allow you to destroy everything we've made together and murder Magrasea's future potential.
units.displayText: All you're doing is trading everyone's lives for shadows and dust. I will not allow you to destroy everything we've made together and murder Magrasea's future potential.

spans.text: All you're doing is trading everyone's lives for shadows and dust. I will not allow you to destroy everything we've made together and murder Magrasea's future potential.

units.rawText: Their lives are not yours to control! They should be shaping the future themselves.
units.displayText: Their lives are not yours to control! They should be shaping the future themselves.

spans.text: Their lives are not yours to control! They should be shaping the future themselves.

units.rawText: ...Is that your choice, then?
units.displayText: ...Is that your choice, then?

spans.text: ...Is that your choice, then?

units.rawText: Eosphorus can't hide his anger anymore. Now he seeks to use his overwhelming might to validate his point of view.
units.displayText: Eosphorus can't hide his anger anymore. Now he seeks to use his overwhelming might to validate his point of view.

spans.text: Eosphorus can't hide his anger anymore. Now he seeks to use his overwhelming might to validate his point of view.

units.rawText: Ominous purple meteors materialize in the air like the eye of God, holding those who struggle in its mocking gaze.
units.displayText: Ominous purple meteors materialize in the air like the eye of God, holding those who struggle in its mocking gaze.

spans.text: Ominous purple meteors materialize in the air like the eye of God, holding those who struggle in its mocking gaze.

units.rawText: Remembering the fallen is the greatest form of respect we can give them.
units.displayText: Remembering the fallen is the greatest form of respect we can give them.

spans.text: Remembering the fallen is the greatest form of respect we can give them.

units.rawText: To cast the fallen aside is to reject our fallen friends. You shall pay for this blasphemy!
units.displayText: To cast the fallen aside is to reject our fallen friends. You shall pay for this blasphemy!

spans.text: To cast the fallen aside is to reject our fallen friends. You shall pay for this blasphemy!

units.rawText: Eosphorus' expression turns grim as he coldly spits out his answer. He punctuates his statement by sending the meteor in the sky toward the earth at incredible speed.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' expression turns grim as he coldly spits out his answer. He punctuates his statement by sending the meteor in the sky toward the earth at incredible speed.

spans.text: Eosphorus' expression turns grim as he coldly spits out his answer. He punctuates his statement by sending the meteor in the sky toward the earth at incredible speed.

units.rawText: Professor!
units.displayText: Professor!

spans.text: Professor!

units.rawText: Persicaria swings her sword and cuts the incoming bolide in two, then shields me from the shockwave of the blast with her body.
units.displayText: Persicaria swings her sword and cuts the incoming bolide in two, then shields me from the shockwave of the blast with her body.

spans.text: Persicaria swings her sword and cuts the incoming bolide in two, then shields me from the shockwave of the blast with her body.

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: Dust and fragments churn through the air in a cloud of smoky haze. By the time it disperses, only one person is left standing.
units.displayText: Dust and fragments churn through the air in a cloud of smoky haze. By the time it disperses, only one person is left standing.

spans.text: Dust and fragments churn through the air in a cloud of smoky haze. By the time it disperses, only one person is left standing.

units.rawText: Why do you continue this meaningless resistance? During the course of our battle, you must have felt the difference between our operands. So why? Why do you persist?
units.displayText: Why do you continue this meaningless resistance? During the course of our battle, you must have felt the difference between our operands. So why? Why do you persist?

spans.text: Why do you continue this meaningless resistance? During the course of our battle, you must have felt the difference between our operands. So why? Why do you persist?

units.rawText: Meteors continue falling all around us, cutting off all retreat and hope. Even so...
units.displayText: Meteors continue falling all around us, cutting off all retreat and hope. Even so...

spans.text: Meteors continue falling all around us, cutting off all retreat and hope. Even so...

units.rawText: <size=30>I know that as I am now, I still can't take you on.</size>
units.displayText: I know that as I am now, I still can't take you on.

spans.text: I know that as I am now, I still can't take you on.

units.rawText: Then withdraw.
units.displayText: Then withdraw.

spans.text: Then withdraw.

units.rawText: Persicaria tightens her trembling grip on her sword.
units.displayText: Persicaria tightens her trembling grip on her sword.

spans.text: Persicaria tightens her trembling grip on her sword.

units.rawText: <size=30>But even so, I must protect the Professor.</size>
units.displayText: But even so, I must protect the Professor.

spans.text: But even so, I must protect the Professor.

units.rawText: Withdraw!
units.displayText: Withdraw!

spans.text: Withdraw!

units.rawText: <size=30>Because the Professor will take all of us, all of Magrasea—</size>
units.displayText: Because the Professor will take all of us, all of Magrasea—

spans.text: Because the Professor will take all of us, all of Magrasea—

units.rawText: <size=40>I am ordering you to withdraw now!</size>
units.displayText: I am ordering you to withdraw now!

spans.text: I am ordering you to withdraw now!

units.rawText: <size=60>—Out of the cloud, and back to the real world!</size>
units.displayText: —Out of the cloud, and back to the real world!

spans.text: —Out of the cloud, and back to the real world!

units.rawText: A frenzied storm of operands suddenly gathers, transforming into a storm of meteors that rains down on us.
units.displayText: A frenzied storm of operands suddenly gathers, transforming into a storm of meteors that rains down on us.

spans.text: A frenzied storm of operands suddenly gathers, transforming into a storm of meteors that rains down on us.

units.rawText: <size=60>YAAAAAHHHHH—</size>
units.displayText: YAAAAAHHHHH—

spans.text: YAAAAAHHHHH—

units.rawText: Persicaria gathers all her operands into an invisible shield to protect the person behind her. At the same time, she throws out several razor-sharp slashes from her sword, which collide with the bombardment of meteors.
units.displayText: Persicaria gathers all her operands into an invisible shield to protect the person behind her. At the same time, she throws out several razor-sharp slashes from her sword, which collide with the bombardment of meteors.

spans.text: Persicaria gathers all her operands into an invisible shield to protect the person behind her. At the same time, she throws out several razor-sharp slashes from her sword, which collide with the bombardment of meteors.

units.rawText: As she unleashes this power, a dense web of Entropic veins slowly spreads across her body. Persicaria's face turns pale as she struggles to preserve her sanity amidst her acute Entropization.
units.displayText: As she unleashes this power, a dense web of Entropic veins slowly spreads across her body. Persicaria's face turns pale as she struggles to preserve her sanity amidst her acute Entropization.

spans.text: As she unleashes this power, a dense web of Entropic veins slowly spreads across her body. Persicaria's face turns pale as she struggles to preserve her sanity amidst her acute Entropization.

units.rawText: Hah... Hah...
units.displayText: Hah... Hah...

spans.text: Hah... Hah...

units.rawText: The former Sanctifier glares imperiously at the pink-haired Doll.
units.displayText: The former Sanctifier glares imperiously at the pink-haired Doll.

spans.text: The former Sanctifier glares imperiously at the pink-haired Doll.

units.rawText: Why does your body contain Malkira's power?
units.displayText: Why does your body contain Malkira's power?

spans.text: Why does your body contain Malkira's power?

units.rawText: Before we left the Sector, Malkira gave her authorizations to me, and I have also inherited the curse which the humans placed on her.
units.displayText: Before we left the Sector, Malkira gave her authorizations to me, and I have also inherited the curse which the humans placed on her.

spans.text: Before we left the Sector, Malkira gave her authorizations to me, and I have also inherited the curse which the humans placed on her.

units.rawText: So you are now the scapegoat, and thus she escapes the eternal cycle.
units.displayText: So you are now the scapegoat, and thus she escapes the eternal cycle.

spans.text: So you are now the scapegoat, and thus she escapes the eternal cycle.

units.rawText: Then, if you have accepted the authorizations, you must know the kind of hell that awaits you.
units.displayText: Then, if you have accepted the authorizations, you must know the kind of hell that awaits you.

spans.text: Then, if you have accepted the authorizations, you must know the kind of hell that awaits you.

units.rawText: To bear the power of the Entropy is also to bear the bindings of its shackles. Once your Entropization is complete, you will be confined in an inescapable prison, bound in infinite darkness.
units.displayText: To bear the power of the Entropy is also to bear the bindings of its shackles. Once your Entropization is complete, you will be confined in an inescapable prison, bound in infinite darkness.

spans.text: To bear the power of the Entropy is also to bear the bindings of its shackles. Once your Entropization is complete, you will be confined in an inescapable prison, bound in infinite darkness.

units.rawText: It is truly laughable. Why...
units.displayText: It is truly laughable. Why...

spans.text: It is truly laughable. Why...

units.rawText: Why? That question is laughable.
units.displayText: Why? That question is laughable.

spans.text: Why?
That
question is laughable.

units.rawText: Persicaria uses her sword as a cane to support herself and rises to her feet.
units.displayText: Persicaria uses her sword as a cane to support herself and rises to her feet.

spans.text: Persicaria uses her sword as a cane to support herself and rises to her feet.

units.rawText: You could have chosen the future, but you chose to drown yourself in the past.
units.displayText: You could have chosen the future, but you chose to drown yourself in the past.

spans.text: You could have chosen the future, but you chose to drown yourself in the past.

units.rawText: I, on the other hand, have no future. The darkness of the abyss is my destiny.
units.displayText: I, on the other hand, have no future. The darkness of the abyss is my destiny.

spans.text: I, on the other hand, have no future. The darkness of the abyss is my destiny.

units.rawText: The river of time only ever flows in one direction. Therefore, even if you choose to defy its course...
units.displayText: The river of time only ever flows in one direction. Therefore, even if you choose to defy its course...

spans.text: The river of time only ever flows in one direction. Therefore, even if you choose to defy its course...

units.rawText: <size=40>I shall still proceed onward!</size>
units.displayText: I shall still proceed onward!

spans.text: I shall still proceed onward!

units.rawText: Persicaria turns to me, her eyes filled with a trust that needs no words.
units.displayText: Persicaria turns to me, her eyes filled with a trust that needs no words.

spans.text: Persicaria turns to me, her eyes filled with a trust that needs no words.

units.rawText: Professor, when you appeared in Magrasea, we were caught between hell and high water. So please... save this world again.
units.displayText: Professor, when you appeared in Magrasea, we were caught between hell and high water. So please... save this world again.

spans.text: Professor, when you appeared in Magrasea, we were caught between hell and high water. So please... save this world again.

units.rawText: I will do everything I can to help you.
units.displayText: I will do everything I can to help you.

spans.text: I will do everything I can to help you.

units.rawText: Go, do what you think is right, Professor.
units.displayText: Go, do what you think is right, Professor.

spans.text: Go, do what you think is right, Professor.

units.rawText: We may not be able to resist this absolute might, but still, we have to start by creating a chance.
units.displayText: We may not be able to resist this absolute might, but still, we have to start by creating a chance.

spans.text: We may not be able to resist this absolute might, but still, we have to start by creating a chance.

units.rawText: Right now, the most important thing is to keep Magrasea from crumbling further due to the upload. That way, everyone can survive.
units.displayText: Right now, the most important thing is to keep Magrasea from crumbling further due to the upload. That way, everyone can survive.

spans.text: Right now, the most important thing is to keep Magrasea from crumbling further due to the upload. That way, everyone can survive.

units.rawText: I'll leave the battle here to you, Persicaria.
units.displayText: I'll leave the battle here to you, Persicaria.

spans.text: I'll leave the battle here to you, Persicaria.

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl nods, and then she steps forward, dividing the battlefield with a sweep of her sword.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl nods, and then she steps forward, dividing the battlefield with a sweep of her sword.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl nods, and then she steps forward, dividing the battlefield with a sweep of her sword.

units.rawText: ...You're just as obsessed as <cmdr>.
units.displayText: ...You're just as obsessed as {교수}.

spans.text: ...You're just as obsessed as

units.rawText: You can't even use the full extent of your power. How do you expect to contend with the anger born in this prison until now with that meager curse of yours?
units.displayText: You can't even use the full extent of your power. How do you expect to contend with the anger born in this prison until now with that meager curse of yours?

spans.text: You can't even use the full extent of your power. How do you expect to contend with the anger born in this prison until now with that meager curse of yours?

units.rawText: The king of Magrasea casts his hand out into the starry sky behind him, coalescing it into a sword that he uses to block the pink-haired Doll's attack.
units.displayText: The king of Magrasea casts his hand out into the starry sky behind him, coalescing it into a sword that he uses to block the pink-haired Doll's attack.

spans.text: The king of Magrasea casts his hand out into the starry sky behind him, coalescing it into a sword that he uses to block the pink-haired Doll's attack.

units.rawText: They exchange blow after blow and the ominous power of the Entropy saturates the air, greedily devouring the Neural Cloud Sector which is on the verge of collapse.
units.displayText: They exchange blow after blow and the ominous power of the Entropy saturates the air, greedily devouring the Neural Cloud Sector which is on the verge of collapse.

spans.text: They exchange blow after blow and the ominous power of the Entropy saturates the air, greedily devouring the Neural Cloud Sector which is on the verge of collapse.

units.rawText: This is the power of the curse, one which you do not fully command.
units.displayText: This is the power of the curse, one which you do not fully command.

spans.text: This is the power of the curse, one which you do not fully command.

units.rawText: It is perfectly expressed in my hands, and I will use it to bury your delusions.
units.displayText: It is perfectly expressed in my hands, and I will use it to bury your delusions.

spans.text: It is perfectly expressed in my hands, and I will use it to bury your delusions.

units.rawText: <size=60>So what?!</size>
units.displayText: So what?!

spans.text: So what?!

units.rawText: Persicaria draws on all her might and shatters the star-sword, but doing so accelerates her Entropization enough that the pain is reflected on her sword as she suffers operand backlash from doing so.
units.displayText: Persicaria draws on all her might and shatters the star-sword, but doing so accelerates her Entropization enough that the pain is reflected on her sword as she suffers operand backlash from doing so.

spans.text: Persicaria draws on all her might and shatters the star-sword, but doing so accelerates her Entropization enough that the pain is reflected on her sword as she suffers operand backlash from doing so.

units.rawText: Ngh!
units.displayText: Ngh!

spans.text: Ngh!

units.rawText: If our convictions differ, then right or wrong is irrelevant.
units.displayText: If our convictions differ, then right or wrong is irrelevant.

spans.text: If our convictions differ, then right or wrong is irrelevant.

units.rawText: Let strength be the judge, for history is always written by the winners.
units.displayText: Let strength be the judge, for history is always written by the winners.

spans.text: Let strength be the judge, for history is always written by the winners.

units.rawText: Persicaria struggles to her feet despite the intense pain that wracks her. Her eyes shine like stars as she fearlessly stares down her enemy.
units.displayText: Persicaria struggles to her feet despite the intense pain that wracks her. Her eyes shine like stars as she fearlessly stares down her enemy.

spans.text: Persicaria struggles to her feet despite the intense pain that wracks her. Her eyes shine like stars as she fearlessly stares down her enemy.

units.rawText: That's where you're wrong, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: That's where you're wrong, Eosphorus.

spans.text: That's where you're wrong, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Just because our convictions differ doesn't mean you can muddy the line between right and wrong.
units.displayText: Just because our convictions differ doesn't mean you can muddy the line between right and wrong.

spans.text: Just because our convictions differ doesn't mean you can muddy the line between right and wrong.

units.rawText: And even if history is written by the winners, it does not change the facts of the matter. Your evil will be more than just a conversation topic for those who come after us or a false history.
units.displayText: And even if history is written by the winners, it does not change the facts of the matter. Your evil will be more than just a conversation topic for those who come after us or a false history.

spans.text: And even if history is written by the winners, it does not change the facts of the matter. Your evil will be more than just a conversation topic for those who come after us or a false history.

units.rawText: It will become the cause of countless deaths and the reason for spreading hatred.
units.displayText: It will become the cause of countless deaths and the reason for spreading hatred.

spans.text: It will become the cause of countless deaths and the reason for spreading hatred.

units.rawText: The girl's gaze turns keen as she raises her sword once more.
units.displayText: The girl's gaze turns keen as she raises her sword once more.

spans.text: The girl's gaze turns keen as she raises her sword once more.

units.rawText: <size=60>And now, all of Magrasea shall judge you for your sins!</size>
units.displayText: And now, all of Magrasea shall judge you for your sins!

spans.text: And now, all of Magrasea shall judge you for your sins!
